steps.note: The milk is heated and held, as in ordinary yoghurt making.
Culture is added after cooling to fermentation temperature, and the milk ferments until it reaches the target pH.
The curd is taken at fermentation temperature to a fresh cheese separator, which draws off the acid whey.
The curd is cooled at once in a heat exchanger to stop the souring.

sources.text: The sequence of heating, culture, fermentation, separating the whey from the curd and cooling, from an equipment maker. It gives no temperatures or times.
